questions.q: Can a notebook run any code on its own, without being attached to a cluster?
options: No — it's just a saved sequence of cells, no more capable of executing than an unopened .py file
Yes, notebooks execute their own code independently of any cluster
Only Markdown cells can run without a cluster attached
Only if the notebook is stored in the Shared folder
questions.explain: Running any cell requires a live Spark cluster to actually execute the code against.

questions.q: What does attaching a notebook to a cluster actually create?
options: A live session — a connection between the notebook and that cluster's driver node
A permanent copy of the cluster dedicated only to that notebook
A new Unity Catalog schema
A scheduled job that runs automatically every night
questions.explain: Running a cell sends its code to the driver, which executes it and streams the output back.

questions.q: What happens to a notebook's variables and DataFrames when it's detached?
options: They're all cleared — everything that existed only in that session's memory disappears
They're automatically saved to a Delta table
They remain available the next time the notebook is opened, from anywhere
Nothing changes; detaching only affects the cluster, not the notebook's state
questions.explain: Reattaching, even to the same cluster, starts completely fresh — nothing carries over automatically.

questions.q: If two notebooks are attached to the same running cluster, do they share variables and DataFrames?
options: No — they share the cluster's compute resources, but each notebook keeps its own separate variables and temp views
Yes, any DataFrame created in one is immediately visible in the other
Only temp views are shared; regular variables are not
It depends on which language each notebook uses
questions.explain: Shared compute, but isolated state — a DataFrame in Notebook A isn't visible in Notebook B.

questions.q: What happens if you attach a notebook to a cluster that isn't running yet?
options: Attaching starts the cluster, which can take a couple of minutes the first time
The attach action fails immediately with an error
The notebook automatically switches to a different, already-running cluster
It silently does nothing until the cluster is manually started elsewhere
questions.explain: Once running, the session behaves the same as attaching to an already-running cluster.
